title: Stripe pricing - 0.8%-4.9% + flat fee per transaction, no monthly fee
clean_text: Stripe charges no monthly fee, setup cost, or minimum: US card transactions are 2.9% + $0.30 online, 2.7% + $0.05 in-person, 3.4% + $0.30 for keyed-in transactions, ACH is 0.8% capped at $5, and disputes cost $15 each. International cards add 1 percentage point and currency conversion adds another 1 percentage point, so international transactions can reach roughly 4.9% + $0.30. Add-on products such as Billing (+0.7%) and Invoicing (+0.4-0.5%) stack on top. Venture-backed startups can get fee credits via the Stripe Startups Program; businesses processing $5M+ annually can negotiate custom Enterprise pricing.
